system.description:
Founded in Eltor by Colby Barr and now spread across Arneyan, the College is the continent's foremost bardic institution. Members represent it wherever they go and rise through Apprentice, Journeyman, Professor, Master and Head Master.

  • Formal Research: Legend Lore checks on subjects you have formally researched or published on have Advantage. Once per round, as part of your action, you can lecture on a creature you can see: allies have Advantage on checks to identify, recall or research it, and its first attack each round against an ally who can hear you has Disadvantage. One creature can be under your lecture at a time.
    • 9th level: two creatures can be under your lecture at once.
  • College Reputation: Advantage on Charisma checks when invoking the College's name, and on Decipher Script checks on any written work.
